Subject: Benchmarking window & acceptance criteria (Wyvern)

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the intro yesterday. Procurement is asking us to lock down a short, concrete acceptance window for the inference benchmarking portion of onboarding so they can align budget and sign-off. Can you confirm the following so we can calendar the tests: 

- How long a test window do you need for a representative throughput run?
- What specific SLAs/targets will you be validating (p50/p95 latency, sustained throughput, error-rate thresholds)?
- Will Redwood provide the load harness and logs, or should we run our own script?

We'd like to schedule the run next Tuesday (11/09) morning PT if that works. Also, please attach the acceptance checklist and any artifacts you expect us to produce.

—Alex
Alex Summers
Head of Platform Integrations, Wyvern Health
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Summers <alex@wyvernhealth.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@wyvernhealth.com>, Wyvern Health Procurement <procurement@wyvernhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Benchmarking window & acceptance criteria (Wyvern)

Hi Alex — great questions. Short answer: we can execute a representative throughput + latency validation in a single half-day window if we pre-stage test data and confirm the traffic mix. Below are the specifics and the plan I propose.

Acceptance targets (what we'll validate)
- Latency: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 250ms, p99 < 600ms (measured per-request end-to-end from Wyvern test client to Redwood hosted endpoint)
- Throughput: sustained 500 req/s with burst capacity to 750 req/s for short spikes (2–5 minutes) without >1% error rate
- Error budget: overall request error rate <= 1.0%; no more than two consecutive 1-minute windows above 1.5%
- Functional: sample-set output quality check (we'll exchange 100 canonical prompts — pass threshold 95% match on expected structured fields)

Test window and cadence
- Pre-run validation (remote, no-load): Mon 11/08 10:00–11:00 PT — smoke check, auth, test payloads
- Benchmark run: Tue 11/09 09:00–13:00 PT — ramp to target, 60m sustained run at 500 req/s, two 5-min spike windows at 750 req/s, cool down
- Results review: Tue 11/09 15:00–16:00 PT — readout and next actions

What Redwood will provide
- Load harness script (JMeter) and recommended ramp profile (attached: wyvern_ramp_script.jmx)
- A shared S3 (or pre-approved upload) for test traces and raw logs; we'll generate a post-test summary PDF and raw logs
- A short checklist for acceptance artifacts (attached: wyvern_load_plan_v1.xlsx)

What we need from Wyvern
- Confirm the 100 canonical prompts by EOD Mon 11/08 (Lena, can you own?)
- Provide network egress IP range or allowlist for our test controllers
- Confirm assertion on functional-check owners (who will sign the quality check)

If that schedule works I'll lock the infra and invite the readout calendar. If you prefer afternoon PT instead of morning, we can flip.

Thanks — looking forward to this run.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: wyvern_load_plan_v1.xlsx, wyvern_ramp_script.jmx

Subject: Internal: Wyvern benchmark run — responsibilities and preflight checklist

Team — please see Alex's ask (below) and my proposed schedule. We need a tight run and a clean readout. Actions by EOD Mon 11/08 unless noted: 

Monica: owner for infra pre-provisioning — please confirm Dedicated pool (or hosted capacity) scaling profile and reserve the nodes for Tue 09:00–14:00 PT. Ensure KV cache warmup plan included and confirm GPU kernel selection for model variant 'rwd-llama-13b-q4' for the run.

Ben: owner for load harness & monitoring — validate the attached JMeter script and add hooks for token-level latency traces. Ensure Prometheus dashboards cover p50/p95/p99 and error rates; set alert thresholds to avoid noisy paging during ramp. Coordinate with infra to capture raw logs to S3 path: s3://redwood-logs/wyvern/2027-11-09/.

Marissa: owner for post-test artifact prep & quality check — once we have raw responses, run the 100-sample field-matching script and prepare post-test-summary.pdf. We'll need a prepared slide with the pass/fail table for Tue readout.

Notes:
- We'll run the smoke validation Mon 10:00–11:00 PT (no load); please be on-call for quick fixes.
- If any infra constraint prevents sustaining 500 req/s, call out mitigations (e.g., temporary increase in batch size, short model variant downgrade) and pre-approve fallbacks in Slack #onboard-wyvern.

Thanks all — ping me if anything blocks.

Tessa
